Package entities

Class Opening_Hours

java.lang.Object
entities.Opening_Hours
public class Opening_Hours extends Object
Represents the operating hours of the restaurant. Includes regular weekly schedules and specific date exceptions. Each time slot now tracks its active status to sync correctly with the database.
